Diogo will give the talk **"IA na redação científica: ética, regras editoriais e
boas práticas de reporte"** at the annual meeting of the Graduate Programme in
Animal Biology at UFMS (October 2026), and again at UNILA, Foz do Iguaçu, in
December 2026.

A companion hands-on workshop, **"IA na revisão de literatura"**, runs on
**19 October 2026** for the same programme.
